marketNotes.text: 2026-10-23: Electropolis now opens in a browser after an automatic bot check and lists four LTO-10 cartridges directly. Quantum MR-L10MQN-01 at €277.81 is the cheapest LTO-10 cartridge found in Spain; HPE Q2080A runs €292.42 to €320.05 there.

2026-10-23: Senetic raised its HPE single-cartridge prices since September: C7976A €52.51 to €57.64, C7977A €79.87 to €90.02, Q2079A €113.49 to €124.24 (IVA incl.). Its HPE BC022A LTO-8 internal drive went from a €5,636 sale price to €11,098 and is out of stock.

2026-10-23: PcComponentes shows a bot-check page to automated browsers, so its prices come from idealo.es (C7976A €58.00, C7977A €93.65, Q2079A €115.78). Its September marketplace listings for drives and the IBM LTO-6 could not be checked and were dropped.
2026-10-23: eComputer and Electronicamente now load and list the HPE P77034-B25 LTO-9 internal drive bundled with five LTO-9 cartridges at €10,809.00 and €9,081.57 (IVA incl.); both are out of stock.

Spain has enough sellers for its own price layer: over 20 Spain-serving sellers (Spanish shops, EU shops with Spanish storefronts, Amazon.es, Carrefour.es and PcComponentes marketplaces). Lines that still need the German fallback: LTO-10 40TB (one listing), LTO-9 and LTO-10 WORM (two each), LTO-6 drives (one out-of-stock internal listing, no external), and all LTO-10 drives.
No standalone LTO-10 drive is listed at any Spain-serving seller checked. LTO-10 drives appear only inside Qualstar libraries and as library drive options at Neovideo.

HPE LTO-9 drives cost far more than Quantum in Spain: BC040A is €15,594 (Bechtle) and €17,347 (Senetic), P84142-B25 is €14,698 (Bechtle), while Quantum TC-L92AN-BR is €9,588 (Bixoto). Senetic's BC042A at €6,661 is out of stock.
Bechtle ES sells only to businesses and public bodies. Its pages lead with the net price and show the gross price beside it; the gross (IVA incl.) figure is recorded.
Neovideo and MasQueVideo (broadcast resellers in Barcelona) show prices without IVA; these are recorded as shown with vatIncluded false.

idealo.es prices include IVA but not shipping. Offers from ManoMano, eBay, OnBuy, Miravia and Kaufland marketplace sellers were left out because they sit well above retail: HPE C7977A ran €84.68 to €167.99 there on 2026-10-23, against €73.05 to €93.65 at shops.
Bixoto shows most LTO items as a special offer against a list price; those datapoints carry the note 'sale'.

MagStor and Symply drives are sold in Spain only as Thunderbolt or USB desktop units, so they are left out of the SAS drive lines; USB-only Unitex units are left out too. Example: Symply SY-SYPRO-DT3L9H1B LTO-9 Thunderbolt at €9,999 excl. IVA (MasQueVideo).
No Sony LTO media was found at any Spain-serving seller.
